title: A Unified Hessian-Guided Framework for Post-Training Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2610.40345v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Low-bit quantization enables efficient deployment of large language models by reducing memory footprint and computational cost. Achieving high accuracy at low precision requires selecting quantization ranges, linear transformations, and weight rounding decisions. Existing approaches typically optimize these components independently using local reconstruction objectives, which fail to account for the varying impact of quantization errors on downstream predictions. Direct optimization of task-level metrics would provide a more faithful objective, but is challenging due to the discontinuous nature of quantization operations and the high computational cost of evaluating their downstream effects.   In this work, we derive a Hessian-guided approximation of the output change induced by joint weight and activation quantization. translated_title: 一种统一的Hessian引导的训练后量化框架
translated_abstract: 低比特量化通过减少内存占用和计算成本，使大语言模型能够高效部署。要在低精度下实现高准确率，需要选择量化范围、线性变换以及权重舍入决策。现有方法通常使用局部重构目标对这些组件进行独立优化，未能考虑量化误差对下游预测的不同影响。直接优化任务级指标本可以提供更忠实的目标，但由于量化操作的不连续性以及评估其下游影响所需的高计算成本，这极具挑战性。在本工作中，我们推导了一种由Hessian矩阵引导的近似方法，用于估计联合权重与激活量化所引起的输出变化。基于一种易于处理的Fisher近似，我们构建了一个统一的训练后量化框架，使…
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于Hessian引导近似的统一训练后量化框架，通过可处理的Fisher近似联合优化量化范围、线性变换和权重舍入决策，从而更好地刻画量化误差对下游任务预测的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified Hessian-guided post-training quantization framework that jointly optimizes quantization ranges, linear transformations, and weight rounding decisions using a tractable Fisher approximation, thereby better capturing the impact of quantization errors on downstream task predictions.
